title: Anthropic falls below IPO price as Nvidia gives back gains
summary: In this edition of Sozzi Unleashed: At The Close, Brian Sozzi sorts through "reality trading" as Nvidia slides nearly 7% after Monday's 31% surge and Anthropic falls below its $83 IPO price less than a week after the biggest offering in history. GCG Advisory Partners' Bill Gunderson makes the case that Nvidia is the cheapest growth stock in the market at nine times forward earnings and names Nvidia and Eli Lilly as his top picks for 2027. Brian breaks down Dell's blowout quarter and $132 billion AI backlog, and HPE CEO Antonio Neri joins to explain the company's raised outlook, why it refuses to finance neoclouds, and whether server margins have peaked. Brian closes by arguing the AI trade is reaching consumers' wallets, pointing to Best Buy's strongest comparable sales growth in five years.

title: Microsoft declares a code red in the middle of a 'Patchpocalypse'
summary: After a 24-hour outage, Microsoft is racing to speed up fixes that took nearly a week to reach customers.

title: Who is holding Jensen Huang accountable? It sure looks like nobody
summary: Sozzi Unleashed host Brian Sozzi digs into day two of Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia. Including a Financial Times report that interim CEO Colette Kress was left out of the talks to bring Huang back, a Wall Street Journal report that Huang disclosed more affairs to the board than previously known, why Brian says Nvidia is effectively a "board of one," and what history says about returning founders from Steve Jobs and Howard Schultz to Kevin Plank.

title: Nvidia-Backed Nscale Reportedly Eyes Private Route As AI Market Sell-Off Clouds $35B IPO Plans
summary: Data center operator Nscale reassured employees it can stay private amid a steep AI stock downturn that threatens its planned $35 billion listing.

title: A week on, Chase still hasn’t explained its outage
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent named JPMorganChase while explaining how patches can cause glitches. Asked if a patch caused its outage, the bank wouldn't say.

title: Best Buy also among companies benefiting from AI boom
summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi  looks at Best Buy's (BBY) strongest comparable sales growth in five years as a sign that AI demand is reaching consumers' wallets through device upgrades, and not showing up through data-center spending on Nvidia (NVDA), Microsoft (MSFT), and Amazon (AMZN).
